product_metadata.title: Leeden Decorative Throw Pillow Covers 20 x 20 inches with 3D Ruffles, Soft Square Cushion Cover Pillow Cases Set of 2, Christmas Cushion Cases for Sofa Couch Bedroom Living Room Home Decor, Green
features: 【UNIQUE 3D RUFFLE DESIGN】Our decorative throw pillow covers have exquisite 3D ruffle patterns, they will make your home more elegant and decorate your room in a simple and fashionable way. These square pillowcases are suitable for bed, couch, sofa, car, office, balcony, patio, etc.

【ULTRA SOFT FABRIC】These throw pillow shams are made of soft polyester fiber, which is cozy and skin-friendly. The ruffles touched fluffy and comfortable, it’s the perfect choice for you and your family use.
【INVISIBLE ZIPPER】 Designed with an invisible zipper closure for an elegant look, and easy insertion and removal. Works smoothly and makes cleaning care more convenient.
【Exquisite Craftsmanship】All of these throw pillowcases are handmade with love. With high-quality fabric and firm stitching, our pillow covers are durable for long time use.
【EASY CARE】NO Fading, no pilling, the couch throw pillow cover is machine washable. Gently Cycle Only, No Bleach, and Tumble Dry Low. Stays the same and as new after every wash.
【PACKAGE INCLUDES】Package includes 2 Pcs throw pillow cases, 20" x 20", compatible with your 20"x20" or 22"x22" pillow inserts. Inserts are NOT included.
